text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Wednesday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- Lithuanian and Latvian security department officials busted three Lithuanians suspected of drug smuggling earlier this week. The dealers are suspected of importing both marijuana and synthetic drugs.
- The rector of Vilnius University Rolandas Povilionis is mulling the idea of running in December's presidential election.
- If Rimantas Pleikys heads the presidential campaign of Vytautas Landsbergis he will have to leave the post of communications minister.
- Kraft Jacobs Suchard Lietuva raised the price for Lithuania's most popular coffee brand Jacobs by an average of 13 percent.
- Siauliu Bank reported a 568,000 litas profit in the first four months of the year.
- Lithuania's Social Democrats are still determined to organise a referendum on the government's plans to privatise key enterprises in the energy, transport and communication sectors.
- The Christian Democratic Party might re-elect its board during the council meeting on Saturday. The leadership of the party is dissatisfied with its poor perfomance in the recent local elections.
- Today marks the 25th anniversary of Romas Kalanta's self-immolation in the centre of Kaunas in protest against the Soviet regime. His fiery suicide sparked huge anti-Soviet riots in the city.
- Lithuanian basketball star Rimas Kurtinaitis will take the post of the director of Lithuania's sports department on June 1.
- Lithuania's Verso Zinios, Latvia's Dienas bizness and Estonia's Aripaev will start publishing a joint stock index of 30 companies of the three Baltic countries on May 20.
- The newspaper publishes its supplement on capital markets in Lithuania.

- Two fund managers from Merrill Lynch and Nomura visited eight Lithuanian companies on the suggestion of Suprema brokerage house. They showed a major interest in Ragutis, Dirbtinis Pluoshtas and Vilniaus Vingis.
- Ukio bank reported a net profit of 948,000 litas during the first four months of the year.
